tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find the companies Yutai covers, the share classes each one has and the tokenized stocks listed for each share class. Answers one page at a time and gives the link to the next page when more companies follow.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Read one company Yutai covers by its legal name, with its share classes and tokenized stocks. Give the two-letter country when two companies share a name.

tools.name: list_instruments
tools.description: Read the facts of tokenized stocks and fan tokens by their instrument ids: for a stock, the programme behind it, its legal form and any stock it converts into, and for a fan token, its symbol, its decimals and the club or other organisation it belongs to.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Read the blockchains Yutai covers, each with its tokenizers, stocks, tokenized value, supply and holder figures, and the newest health reading beside them: the live lag in seconds from the safe head to the slowest live token, and the share of its history the backfill has read as a percentage. A chai

tools.name: list_tokenizers
tools.description: Read the tokenizer programmes Yutai covers, each with its issuer, its reach, its tokenized value, its supply and its holder figures.

tools.name: get_market_activity
tools.description: Read one stock's public on-chain activity: its price, 24-hour change, market cap and tokenized value, its holder count, each token's supply and premium by chain and tokenizer, and its recent large movements. Give a chain or a tokenizer to narrow the tokens and the movements.

tools.name: get_recent_movements
tools.description: Read the newest on-chain movements of tokenized stocks: each mint, burn and transfer with its time, stock, token and tokenizer, chain, shares, dollar value at the stored day-close price, both sides as a label or a shortened address, and the transaction hash. Give a stock, chain or tokenizer to narro

tools.name: get_benefit_availability
tools.description: Read the benefits the companies behind one or more tokenized stocks offer in one country, each with what a holder must do to reach it, how it is delivered, and whether it is only an example. Give one or more instrument ids and the two-letter country.

tools.name: find_benefits
tools.description: Find the stocks with Yutai benefits, filtered by chain, tokenizer or country, with each benefit's name, what a holder must do to reach it, and whether it is only an example. A chain may be a plain name such as solana, base or arbitrum. Examples are left out unless you ask for them.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read how each of Yutai's data sources stands today, with a plain sentence for its mode, beside the answer's version, the build and its instant.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Yutai developer docs and read the matching pages as short snippets, each with the page's own address. Give a word or a phrase; the answer names up to the number of pages you ask for, five by default.
